name: Ideaforge Technology Ltd
title: Ideaforge Technology Ltd - 543932 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue Rs141 cr (7x YoY) on ~40% conversion of Q3 open book; FY27 opening book Rs310 cr is all slated for execution in three quarters, with no new order guidance given.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue Rs141 cr vs Rs20.3 cr
triggers.quote: revenue from operations stoodat INR141 crorescomparedtoINR20.3croresinquarter 4FY25

guidance.value: Rs310 cr executed within three quarters

red_flags.label: Management declines to give order inflow or order book breakup

summary.headline: ideaForge Q4 FY26 revenue hit a record INR141 crore with EBITDA margin of 52.6%, while FY26 PAT stayed negative at INR17 crore.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 was the company's highest-ever quarterly revenue and PAT, with about 40% of the Q3 open order book executed in the quarter. FY26 revenue rose to INR286.1 crore from INR161 crore, and EBITDA turned positive at INR27 crore for the year. Management opened FY27 with an order book of about INR310 crore, all slated for execution within roughly three quarters, and signalled a push into combat drones (loitering munitions, strike UAVs) alongside its ISR core. Guidance is limited to a blended FY27 gross margin of 50-55%.

segments.name: Defence
segments.commentary: Forms the bigger share of the order book versus civil; EW-resilient systems were delivered and accepted in Q4 after real-world testing. Combat drone capabilities (loitering munitions, strike, kamikaze) are being added via in-house work and partnerships.

segments.name: Civil and enterprise
segments.commentary: Smaller share of the order book; management is pursuing drone-as-a-service, analytics and enterprise software-led offerings. Power-line tower inspection is a newly addressed market.

segments.name: International
segments.commentary: First US order from Lamar Police Department, Texas, as an early pilot. JV formed with FirstBreach in the US; MoU with Digital Media Professionals Inc. in Japan. Management did not quantify international revenue.

segments.name: YETI (middle-mile logistics)
segments.commentary: Still in development. Military high-altitude heavy logistics is the first target; tentative commercial exploration expected to start in FY27.

guidance_outlook: Blended FY27 gross margin expected at about 50-55%; no quarterly margin guidance given.
Opening FY27 order book of about INR310 crore expected to be executed within roughly the first three quarters of FY27.
Management declined to give FY27 order inflow or revenue projections.
Management expects a very large Indian Armed Forces buying cycle; some large opportunities have been cleared by the Defence Procurement Board but are not yet tendered.
Management says the focus is shifting to drone and drone-defence procurement, with scale expected to grow from a few thousand crore to a much larger number in the next cycle.
capex_capacity: Global supply chain for thermal imagers remains a constraint, per management.
ZOLT order of INR72 crore is still in execution; management said execution is pending because of order timelines.
Hybrid VTOL and vehicle-portable VTOL UAVs and very large logistics UAVs are among the product categories under development.
Q6 and SWITCH next-generation platforms moved into production readiness during the quarter.
Combat drone development will combine in-house technology with partnerships, and management said it does not intend to take munition licences itself for now.
demand_pricing: Order book is a mix across ZOLT, SWITCH, NETRA and Q6 platforms, with defence the much larger share.
Management said customers are moving toward more advanced capabilities at higher volumes, which it expects to improve margin profile.
Management did not disclose order book breakup or win rate, and declined comment on specific tenders (for example the 164-drone government tender).
Fleet completed over 250,000 end-customer flights in FY26 and crossed 950,000 cumulative flights.

qa_highlights.question: What is the execution timeline for the INR310 crore opening order book, and will any of it spill over?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the order book is expected to convert to revenue within the first three quarters of FY27 and was not expected to spill over. New capital-procurement opportunities are yet to be tendered and will take longer.

qa_highlights.question: What margin should be expected for FY27 and beyond?
qa_highlights.answer: Management guided to a blended FY27 margin of about 50-55% and gave no quarterly guidance. It said advanced-capability orders carry higher margins, while mass-market products carry lower margins.

qa_highlights.question: Is the company participating in emergency and capital procurement?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said yes to participation in the emergency procurement and in capital procurement for the current and coming years, without quantifying it.

qa_highlights.question: How is the company approaching combat drones, and what licences are needed?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said combat drones will be built with in-house technology and partners, and that it does not intend to take munition licences itself for now. Its ZOLT platform is expected to be the first to carry munitions.

qa_highlights.question: Is supply chain risk material, for example GNSS chips or thermal imagers?
qa_highlights.answer: Management named global thermal imager supply as a constraint across the industry and did not name other specific subsystems at risk.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company build humanoid or AI robots?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said collaborative autonomy is inevitable, but whether it builds or partners for humanoids will depend on market capability and price.

risks_watch: Quarterly lumpiness: Q4 was a one-off conversion of the Q3 backlog. Watch whether Q1 FY27 revenue holds up after the INR310 crore is partly consumed.
Full-year FY26 PAT is still negative at INR17 crore despite positive EBITDA; watch for the first full-year net profit.
Thermal imager supply constraints and geopolitical supply-chain volatility could slow execution.
Combat-drone entry depends on partnerships and on munition licensing that the company does not yet hold.
Large Indian capital procurement opportunities are not yet tendered; timing is uncertain.
Working capital cycles and procurement timing remain flagged by management as ongoing risks.
summary.management_tone: Confident on Q4 execution and margins, but cautious and guarded on forward numbers. Management declined to give FY27 revenue or order-inflow projections, withheld order-book breakup and specific tender comments, and repeatedly stressed that large opportunities are still in progress.
key_quotes: We have booked our highest ever annual orders of approximately INR530 crores, executed a significant part of the order book in quarter 4, delivered our highest quarterly revenue and PAT and ended the year with positive EBITDA.

rows.label: Margin expansion

rows.why: Q6 and SWITCH moved into production readiness in Q4 FY26, and combat drone capabilities (loitering munitions, strike UAVs) are being added via in-house work and partnerships, with ZOLT expected to carry munitions first.
